title: Giants' Malik Nabers not practicing Friday is 'part of the process' as wideout continues injury recovery

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants' Malik Nabers not practicing Friday is 'part of the process' as wideout continues injury recovery
sources.description: Giants star wide receiver Malik Nabers did not practice on Friday as he works his way back from a torn ACL and lateral meniscus that ended his 2025 season early.
